post.caption:
Wild grains shatter to disperse their seed, which makes them almost impossible to harvest. Humans kept picking the rare mutants that held on, planted those, and within centuries the mutation dominated. Same story with maize from teosinte, and with broccoli, cabbage, kale, sprouts and cauliflower all descending from one wild brassica. Put teosinte next to corn and the natural versus modified distinction stops meaning very much.
